person_note: The controlling narration is third person. Multiple Goodreads passages from different story situations externally narrate Puller and other characters and enter their thoughts without introducing a participating narrator. A sustained Tier A opening excerpt independently shows the same third-person method across a complete scene; the BingeBooks sample extends that same opening rather than supplying an independent interior route. The isolated first-person sentence in the web opening and the second-person commands in q00688 are direct thoughts embedded within third-person narration, while dialogue, maxims, and paratext are non-base material. Confidence is med because no credible whole-book POV source was found and the web evidence is opening-only, despite strong dispersed Goodreads corroboration. Audit: independent review retained THIRD and downgraded high to med after avoiding double-counting the overlapping opening samples.
